notes: Rain from lap 2, drying from about lap 27. Missing: Hakkinen's wet-tyre stop, Alesi's puncture stop after the La Source contact (Jolpica: 7 laps), every midfield car. Safety cars: none before 1993. Weather (step 5.x wet reconstruction): timeline and stop tyres from Motor Sport and Wikipedia; Hakkinen's wet-tyre stop (before lap 8, no lap) is still missing, so his first stint is estimated.

timeline.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/october-1992/8/luck-and-judgement ('It started on a track made so greasy by drizzle just before the start'; the first wet-tyre stops came at the end of lap 3)

https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/october-1992/8/luck-and-judgement ('It was raining quite hard now, however, and gradually the leaders were all obliged to come in for wets'; 'the rain continued and Ayrton's advantage shrank'; Senna gave in on lap 16)
timeline.note: No source describes laps 17-26; held at wet until the drying the sources put just before lap 28.

timeline.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/october-1992/8/luck-and-judgement ('It was also beginning to dry out, and a line was appearing faintly all round the circuit', before Senna's lap-28 slick stop); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1992_Belgian_Grand_Prix ('By the time Thierry Boutsen spun off on lap 28, the track was beginning to dry'); https://www.autosport.com/f1/news/how-schumacher-joined-f1s-elite-5109906/5109906/ (Schumacher's lap-30 'early change to slicks just as the rain stopped')

https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/october-1992/8/luck-and-judgement (slick stops to lap 33); http://motorsportretro.com/2014/04/michael-schumachers-first-win/ ('On a drying track, he ran wide'; 'Schumacher didn't slow, lapping faster and faster')
timeline.note: No source gives the lap the track was dry; ramped from the last slick stops to the first of the race's fastest laps (F1DB: laps 38-42).

timeline.source: http://motorsportretro.com/2014/04/michael-schumachers-first-win/ ('On the penultimate lap he set a time that would have put him fifth on the grid'); F1DB: every finisher's fastest lap on laps 38-42 (Schumacher 1:53.791, lap 39)
timeline.note: Dry pace, not a statement that the track was dry: an owner check.
